title: Secrets: Five Days Before Christmas, 1990
subtitle: I've asked my aunt to tell me this story at least fifteen times.
quote: Secrets started my life and secrets ended his.
label: New essay

captions.instagram:
“Secrets started my life and secrets ended his.”

Five days before Christmas, 1990. My mother, nine months pregnant, stood up in my grandparents' living room like she was going to get another glass of water. Nobody seemed to notice when she didn't come back. Nobody except my aunt.

This is the night I was born, the way my aunt has told it to me at least fifteen times.

New essay on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
